answer.location_description: Whole image: a periodic horizontal-stripe pattern with a period of 4 rows. Bright 2-row bands fall on rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21, alternating with the bands on rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, 14-15, 18-19 and 22-23, across all columns.
answer.mechanism: Units 5, 11 and 15 have negative biases (-46 to -75) and positive weights on rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21, so they look like detectors that turn on when stripes in that phase are present. Units 0, 3, 14, 18, 23, 24, 26 and 28 have large positive biases (75-99) and the opposite phase (positive on rows 2-3, 6-7, ...; negative on rows 0-1, 4-5, ...), so the same stripes push them down. In layer 2, u1, u4 and u8 (output weights +85, +99, +59) take positive input from units 5/11/15 and strongly negative input from the opposite-phase units, so the stripe pattern activates them and raises the malignant logit. u6, u7, u9 and u12 (output weights -55, -73, -56, -69) are driven by the opposite-phase units, so they shut off when the stripes appear, removing benign evidence. Both pathways push the same way.
answer.evidence: The row-periodic structure is not a nodule shape: alternating 2-row bands of same-sign weights span the full width and run from row 0 to row 23. Unit 15 has rows 0-1 at about +30 to +67, rows 2-3 near 0, rows 4-5 at +40 to +75, rows 6-7 near 0, rows 8-9 at +40 to +68, and so on. Unit 14 shows the inverse: rows 0-1 and 4-5 at -30 to -50, rows 2-3 and 6-7 positive. W2 weights for u4: -60 (unit 0), -90 (unit 14), -90 (unit 24), -77 (unit 28) versus +24, +28, +32 from units 5, 11, 15. For u1: -86, -63, -65, -67 from units 23, 24, 26, 28 versus +34, +21, +31 from units 5, 11, 15. For u8: -72, -86, -71, -81 from units 0, 3, 18, 26 versus +28, +58, +38 from units 5, 11, 15. u6, u9 and u12 receive +60 to +99 from the opposite-phase units. The remaining units (1, 2, 4, 6-10, 12, 13, 16, 17, 19-22, 25, 27, 29-31) have small, unstructured noise-like weights.
answer.main_feature: Beyond the stripes, the structured units carry localized central weights, e.g. positive around rows 10-11, cols 16-18 and negative around rows 8-9, cols 10-12 and rows 16-17. This suggests the genuine signal is the nodule's central density, texture and margin, but it is entangled with and dominated by the stripe-pattern detectors.
